description: The Recruta connector links your ATS (Applicant Tracking System) to ChatGPT. Recruiters query and run hiring by chatting: list jobs, view candidate rankings, move pipeline stages, add notes, and schedule interviews — with per-user login (OAuth), strict per-company isolation, and no health data (PHI) exposed. Built for recruiting teams that want to operate their ATS hands-free, right from the chat.
